text:
Which statement describes transition elements?
A
They have high densities and high melting points.
B
They have high densities and low melting points.
C
They have low densities and high melting points.
D
They have low densities and low melting points.

options.label: A
options.text: They have high densities and high melting points.

options.label: B
options.text: They have high densities and low melting points.

options.label: C
options.text: They have low densities and high melting points.

options.label: D
options.text: They have low densities and low melting points.
